title: exit.code@1
description: The deep commands' one exit-code table, as strings: 0 for PASS, 1 for FAIL or a failed item, 2 for a usage error, 3 for anything not decided (BLOCKED, INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE, a code no enum lists among them). When 1 and 3 both apply, 1.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: never: every deep command exits by this table
